name: verifyanyemail
description: Real-time email verification and deliverability diagnostics for AI agents.
long_description: Verify whether email addresses are real and safe to send to, run bulk verification jobs, and check domain deliverability (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC) — all from inside your AI assistant. Backed by the VerifyAnyEmail API.

tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Verify a single email address in real time.

tools.name: verify_batch
tools.description: Submit many addresses for async bulk verification.

tools.name: get_batch_status
tools.description: Poll a bulk verification batch's progress.

tools.name: get_batch_results
tools.description: Fetch a page of batch results.

tools.name: check_mx
tools.description: Look up a domain's MX records.

tools.name: check_dkim
tools.description: Check a domain's DKIM record for a selector.

tools.name: check_domain_health
tools.description: Overall email deliverability health grade for a domain.

api_key.title: VerifyAnyEmail API Key
api_key.description: Your vae_... API key from the VerifyAnyEmail dashboard (Settings → API Keys).
